meta.title: Restart and quit
meta.description: Adds two actions above Settings in the sidebar foot. Restart asks for a confirming press, then restarts the Desktop application and its Host so installed or removed plugins take effect. Quit closes the application completely, including its Host, sidecars, MCP servers, and terminal processes, with a single press. Both interrupt running tasks, and scheduled tasks do not run while the app is closed. The actions appear when the Host runs inside the Windows or macOS Desktop application; plain dsh web and other platforms hide them. Windows is tested; the macOS path is implemented but untested. The sidebar foot is hidden while the sidebar is collapsed, so expand the sidebar to reach the actions.
